'''Darga the Hutt's palace''' was a palace on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. It was originally owned by a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who was a member of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], but he was forced to flee the palace and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] moved in.
He too fled the palace in c. [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Darga's palace]].
